reactor.citiesinlife.not_submerged: The core is not under water. Pour water over the finished stack.
reactor.citiesinlife.not_submerged.at: Rod at %s %s %s is not under water - the whole core must stand flooded.

reactor.citiesinlife.port_missing: Cooling loop incomplete - one of the four ports is missing.
reactor.citiesinlife.port_not_linked: The water input is not linked to a cooled output - draw the link with the Pipe Connect Tool.
reactor.citiesinlife.port_not_linked.at: The water input is not linked to a cooled output. Use the Pipe Connect Tool. Cooled input at %s %s %s.
reactor.citiesinlife.port_not_beside_sto: The cooled input and the heated output must both stand against the uranium storage.
The cooled input and heated output must both touch the uranium storage at %s %s %s.
reactor.citiesinlife.no_pressurized_pipe: No pressurised pipe against the cooled input. It goes last on the cooled run.
No pressurised pipe touching the cooled input at %s %s %s. It goes last on the cooled run.
reactor.citiesinlife.cooled_run_broken: No pipe path from the cooled output to the cooled input - follow the pipes.
reactor.citiesinlife.return_run_broken: No pipe path from the heated output back to the water input - follow the pipes.
reactor.citiesinlife.no_fresh_water: No water reaching the water input - plumb it into the network and check the pumps.
reactor.citiesinlife.core_uncovered: CORE UNCOVERED - the plant is stopped and has lost its passive cooling. Reflood it.
reactor.citiesinlife.core_uncovered.at: CORE UNCOVERED AT %s %s %s - the plant is stopped and has lost its passive cooling. Reflood it.
reactor.citiesinlife.port_clogged: A cooling port has clogged. Clear it with the Repair Tool.
reactor.citiesinlife.no_steam_emitter: No steam emitter - the ports are fouling and the pressure is unvented.
reactor.citiesinlife.pipe_leaking: Leaking pipes on the cooling run. Repair Tool.
reactor.citiesinlife.loop_dead_cold: Cooling loop dead and the core is cold - the reactor will not start. Fix the loop first.
reactor.citiesinlife.pressure_low: Pressure too low to turn the turbines. Close the vent, or let the core warm up.
reactor.citiesinlife.fuel_exhausted: Uranium exhausted - rods cold, no output. Refill the uranium storage.
reactor.citiesinlife.safe_mode_restart: Safeties tripped while unattended - turbine power forced to off.
reactor.citiesinlife.core_overheating: CORE OVERHEATING - throw the COOLER lever, or the turbine dial to zero.
reactor.citiesinlife.core_critical: CORE CRITICAL - MELTDOWN IMMINENT. Turbine dial to zero, NOW.
reactor.citiesinlife.pressure_high: Pressure high - open the relief valve and let the core cool.
reactor.citiesinlife.pressure_bursting: PRESSURE CRITICAL - the vessel is about to burst. Shut the core down.
reactor.citiesinlife.off: Turbine power: OFF. Control rods fully in, core shut down, plant cannot explode.
